name: @cataqui/workerhole
description: Typed portals between Cloudflare Workers and their container applications.

scripts.build: tsdown src/index.ts src/index.node.ts src/index.worker.ts src/worker.ts --tsconfig tsconfig.build.json --format esm --dts --sourcemap --target es2023 --platform neutral --out-dir dist --deps.never-bundle cloudflare:workers --deps.never-bundle node:http
scripts.typecheck: pnpm cf:types && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.consumer.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.runtime.json
